name: MapleStory
about: Carried over from Maplesyrup: what it knew about MapleStory's interface, dialogs, runes, portals and early monsters. Every fact is an original short summary written for Maplesyrup, not text copied from a wiki.

entities.name: Rune
entities.summary: A glowing pillar on a platform; activating it gives a temporary buff.

entities.name: Portal
entities.summary: A shimmering oval that moves the character to another map.

entities.name: Snail
entities.summary: Passive, slow; a first-map training target.

entities.name: Blue Snail
entities.summary: Passive, slow; a little more HP than a Snail.

entities.name: Slime
entities.summary: Passive; hops slowly along a platform, often in clusters.

entities.name: Stump
entities.summary: Stays put until provoked; farmed in tight clusters.

entities.name: Wild Boar
entities.summary: Charges fast once provoked; can knock you back.

entities.name: Ribbon Pig
entities.summary: Charges fast once provoked, like a Wild Boar.

facts.subject: Rune
facts.claim: Runes appear as a glowing pillar at a fixed platform location and expire after a time limit.

facts.subject: Rune
facts.claim: Activating a rune requires standing next to it and pressing an on-screen directional key sequence.

facts.subject: Rune
facts.claim: Successful rune activation grants a temporary buff, commonly move speed, jump or an EXP bonus.

facts.subject: Portal
facts.claim: Hidden portals look like background art until the character walks into their trigger area.

facts.subject: Portal
facts.claim: Boss-room portals usually ask for an entry confirmation before teleporting.

facts.subject: Training
facts.claim: Prefer platforms with the most monsters per screen width: area skills clear more per cast.

facts.subject: Boss
facts.claim: Re-buff before entering a boss room, not mid-fight: boss attacks punish idle animations.

facts.subject: Training
facts.claim: Avoid standing at map edges when monsters are dense: there are fewer ways out.

facts.subject: Training
facts.claim: Judge a training map by the EXP-per-minute trend, not a single reading.

tips.text: Rune's up. Grab it for the buff.
